items.title: March 2026 Google Webmaster Report: Google Discover Update, Listicles, Serving Bug & More
items.summary: This webmaster report highlights SEO implications from the first-ever Google Discover core update, which rolled out over three weeks and may have impacted local rankings, alongside potential hits on self-promotional listicles sites amid ongoing search volatility. Recent Google updates include changes to file size limits causing confusion, an AI-powered Search Console configuration tool going live, new link styles in AI Mode and AI Overviews, and updated business profile review policies leading to review removals.

items.title: Google Tests Bold Site Names In Search Results
items.summary: Google is testing bolding site names in search results, a change spotted by Sachin Patel on X, which may enhance visibility of branded links but is unlikely to significantly impact click-through rates or SEO strategies. This follows Google's history of testing visual tweaks in snippets, similar to Bing's hover effects, potentially influencing how site owners optimize for result prominence.

items.title: Google Updates AI Mode Recipe Sites Results In Response To Backlash
items.summary: Google has updated AI Mode to display more links to recipe creators in response to feedback about synthesized recipes, allowing users to tap on dishes for side panels with overviews and direct site links. This change addresses backlash by improving connections to original sources for searches like “easy dinners for two.” Robby Stein announced the update via X, emphasizing future improvements like adding cook times.

items.title: Book Deals: Week of March 2, 2026
items.summary: Little, Brown acquired North American rights to Chad Harbach’s sophomore novel The Brightness, returning to Westish College 15 years after his debut The Art of Fielding. Park Row preempted world English rights to Erica Bauermeister’s thriller Jayne, following a disenchanted academic turned barista who rises to fame and entanglement. Podium secured a five-book deal for Heather Gay’s debut thriller Eternal Glow, the first in her Bad Mormons series.

items.title: Sarah Barley Books Launches at Simon & Schuster Books for Young Readers
items.summary: Veteran editor Sarah Barley launched her eponymous imprint at Simon & Schuster Books for Young Readers, debuting with two YA bestsellers: Beth Is Dead by Katie Bernet and Love Me Tomorrow by Emiko Jean. Upcoming titles include Heiress of Nowhere by Stacey Lee and Local Gods by Melinda Salisbury. The imprint will release about 10 books per year, focusing on YA and middle grade fiction.

items.title: BookTok Controversy: Viral Video Claims Books Have Been 'Fast-Fashionified'
items.summary: BookTok is buzzing over a viral video accusing books, particularly romantasy, of being 'fast-fashionified' by the platform's algorithm. The critique targets social media trends more than the genre itself, sparking widespread reactions. This highlights tensions in BookTok's influence on reading habits.

items.title: The Writer Whose AOL Email Fictions Became Sacred Texts of Anti-Woke Literature
items.summary: Rex Adler's 1990s email-distributed 'Rex Files' stories, featuring a narrator killing women altered by aliens symbolizing moral decay, have gained cult status in anti-woke indie lit circles. The philosophical tales critique consumer culture and feminism. Adler faced arrest for using real names, adding to their contrarian lore.

items.title: Why Conservative & Christian Fiction Fails (And How to Fix It)
items.summary: Conservative and Christian fiction often prioritizes messaging over character-driven stories, mirroring issues in woke fiction and leading to reader preference for sermons over craft. Successful works like those of Tolkien and C.S. Lewis focus on characters working out salvation through struggles. Christian publishers have adopted woke agendas, limiting true conservative voices.

items.title: NEW: Disney Pixar Removes "Woke" Content After Recent Protests
items.summary: Pixar has scaled back environmentalist messaging in its upcoming film Hoppers to emphasize character-driven storytelling, following criticism of previous agenda-focused releases like Lightyear and Elio. Early reviews praise the film with a 97% Rotten Tomatoes score, though audience response awaits its March 6 release. The changes come amid fan protests over perceived woke content in Disney projects.

items.title: Carrie Underwood remains unapologetic as ‘American Idol’ backlash turns into MAGA battleground
items.summary: Carrie Underwood received boos from the American Idol audience during contestant critiques, sparking online debate linked to her conservative image and inauguration performance. She responded defiantly on the show and social media, refusing to engage in politics. The incident divided fans, with supporters hailing her strength and detractors criticizing her views.

items.title: Backlash mounts to Bafta N-word controversy as Jamie Foxx and Wendell Pierce criticise outburst
items.summary: During the BAFTAs, Tourette syndrome activist John Davidson shouted the N-word involuntarily, leading to celebrity backlash including criticism from Jamie Foxx and Wendell Pierce over the response. BAFTA apologized, citing the complexity of the situation, but some called for stronger accountability. The event fueled discussions on disability, race, and awards show protocols.

items.title: Outrage over anti-woke 'Scary Movie 6' trailer
items.summary: The Scary Movie 6 trailer, released March 2, features a pronoun correction joke amid a stabbing scene, prompting backlash from some viewers labeling it dated and offensive. Marlon Wayans defended the content as equal-opportunity comedy to revive pre-cancel culture humor. Reactions on social media highlight divisions over the film's anti-woke tone.

items.title: The Bear to End with Season 5, Jamie Lee Curtis Says
items.summary: Jamie Lee Curtis revealed that FX's The Bear will wrap up after its fifth season. The series has earned widespread acclaim for its intense portrayal of the restaurant industry. Fans and critics anticipate the finale following its growing success.

items.title: Barbra Streisand in Talks for Oscars Performance to Honor Robert Redford
items.summary: Barbra Streisand is negotiating to perform at the Oscars in tribute to Robert Redford, commemorating their collaboration in The Way We Were. The potential appearance marks a highlight for the awards ceremony. Industry anticipation builds around the legendary singer's involvement.

items.title: Launch Commerce Rebrands from Launch Cart, Unveils AI-Powered Business Platform for Small Businesses
items.summary: Launch Commerce, previously known as Launch Cart, has rebranded and launched a comprehensive AI-powered platform tailored for small businesses to streamline e-commerce operations. The new platform integrates AI features for inventory management, customer personalization, and marketing automation. This product move aims to empower SMBs to scale efficiently without complex setups.

items.title: Rowan Launches AI-Powered Platform to Address Small Business Succession Challenges
items.summary: Rowan has publicly launched an AI-driven succession planning platform designed to connect small business buyers and sellers, facilitating smoother ownership transitions. The tool uses AI to match opportunities, assess valuations, and manage due diligence processes. It targets the growing need for SMB succession amid retiring baby boomers.

items.title: PosterMyWall AI Enables Prompt-Driven Marketing Campaigns for Small Businesses
items.summary: PosterMyWall has introduced a groundbreaking AI tool that allows small businesses to generate complete marketing campaigns—from ideas to published posts—using simple text prompts in one app. It combines image/video generation with scheduling capabilities, making professional marketing accessible without design expertise. This innovation significantly reduces time and cost for SMB marketing efforts.

items.title: Synthreo Secures SAFE Funding to Advance AI Platform for MSPs Serving SMBs
items.summary: Synthreo announced a SAFE funding round led by Vince Kent to accelerate its AI operating system for Managed Service Providers, enabling scalable AI delivery to small and medium businesses. The platform features a no-code agent builder, white-label portal, and multi-tenant management to bridge the AI adoption gap in SMBs. This funding supports expansion amid surging demand for affordable enterprise-grade AI.

items.title: Addepar Launches Addison AI for Natural Language Portfolio Analysis
items.summary: Addepar debuted Addison AI, an innovative tool that enables wealth managers to query and analyze portfolio data using everyday language on its platform. This AI enhances decision-making speed and accuracy for financial advisory firms, many of which are small businesses. The launch represents a meaningful step in AI integration for business analytics.
